What materialized in the sanctuary's central chamber was consciousness-form that carried harmonic signatures of extraordinary capability combined with emotional trauma that approached complete fragmentation.

Young awareness, probably fewer than thirty years of individual existence, but touched with power that suggested either unprecedented natural talent or development through circumstances that had demanded rapid evolution beyond safe parameters.
